control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - permit and isolation certificate records incomplete for P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-4103, PT-4103 and V-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during shift handover while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 9 April 2026 a planned assurance activity of P-4103, PT-4103 and V-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the integrity of the mechanical seal support system not effective.
